name: Monitor Settings
description: Refresh rate, scale, rotation, on/off, mirror/extend, a draggable arrangement and the cursor size for each monitor (haseen hardware monitor), kept across reloads; brightness opens haseen.display. Adapted from juliusmork-sys's Monitor Settings Extender (MIT). Off by default

debugIpc.description: Test hook: expose IPC target haseen.monitor-settings (state, act, drop) from the open panel
